criteria.criterion: A real project overlay compiled through `CriteriaSnapshot` yields one immutable digest-bound view containing effective built-in, project LLM, and project DET policy with source provenance.

A project code-review LLM criterion with an empty, missing, non-list, or blank `applies_to` fails before any model call with its criterion id, configuration location, and the remedy `use ["**"] for repository-wide`.
Given root, nested, and dot changed paths, `applies_to: ["**"]` selects the criterion exactly once.

`applies_to: ["**"]` selects the criterion unconditionally when `changed_files` is empty (the diverging edge), and a contract test asserts this empty-changed-files case selects, proving the `[]`→`["**"]` migration preserves the prior ungated behavior.
A nonmatching scoped glob records a typed non-applicable selection reason without executing the criterion.
A contract test proves `project.review-phase-boundaries` review membership is unchanged by the `[]`→`["**"]` migration, including the empty-changed-files case above.

The shared `_validate_applies_to` empty-list-legal contract is left intact for plan-review project criteria (a negative-control test proves plan-review routing does not adopt the code-review non-empty-glob rule).
Contract tests prove effective built-in disables/retunes are present in the snapshot.
Contract tests prove activated project DET entries are present in the snapshot.
A negative-control test proves built-in secondary-trigger semantics remain unchanged in the snapshot.

An ADR documents snapshot ownership, digest inputs (its reuse of the existing `_overlay_signature` content digest), gate-specific applicability, the prior-art comparison against ADR 0098/0017, compatibility adapters, and the revert-based rollback.
